content.body:
Based on the outstanding performance of the earlier Daimler Scout Car, an up armored and up-gunned version was developed. Bearing the turret of the Tetrarch light tank, the Daimler Mk I had an armament equivalent to most medium tanks of the early war years. It was very mobile and fast off road which gave it the perfect performance profile for an advanced scout.
The Daimler is an exceptional armored car in Battleground Europe. It is armed with a gun that can easily kill all early panzers and is capable of much better off road speed. Its only weakness is its light armor. Driving the Daimler, you can kill enemy tanks, but remember that you cannot forever fight them: your armor will not withstand any sustained gunnery duel with even a light tank, so don't be seduced into thinking you are invincible by all that firepower: you are an armored car.
Use your good speed to move around enemy forces, there is no reason to get stuck in a gunfight when you can fight at your better advantage as a sneaky and highly mobile ambush unit. Come from unexpected directions; lie in wait on roads to kill any reinforcements. It is worth considering always keeping your commander popped out for maximum situational awareness: if you hear a vehicle coming from a direction you don't expect, just leave.
Because it is such a dangerous vehicle in smart hands, you should expect that the Germans will not hesitate to send tactical aircraft or allocate specific forces to killing any Daimler observed poking around or behind their lines.
Control Variations: The driver spawns in buttoned up, but may zoom through the open view slit (numpad . or Del key). The Daimler has no periscope. The gunner has no view slit or range adjustment (gradations only). The Daimler carries only AP ammunition.
content.brief: TYPE: Armored Scout Car ARMAMENT: ROQF 2 Pounder (40 mm) Gun 7.9 mm Besa LMG (1) WEIGHT: 7,514 kg SPEED: 72 km/h (road)
